landing.headline: Your club, in your pocket
landing.subline: Book classes, track your monthly plan, your horse's boarding and riding-school payments — all from your phone, no calls or spreadsheets.
landing.heroNote: No downloads: installs from your browser

book.title: Book your class
book.text: Pick a day and time for your level. See open spots in real time.

plan.title: Your plan updates itself
plan.text: Each booked class is deducted from your monthly package. Cancel in time and it comes back.

pay.title: Pay from your phone
pay.text: Plans, boarding and events in one place. Cards coming soon; cash or transfer at the club.

features.title: Built for families, riders and management

bookings.title: Class bookings
bookings.text: Schedules by level, instructor and arena. No overbooked groups.

plans.title: Monthly plans
plans.text: 4, 8 or 12-class packages with progress and expiry date at a glance.

boarding.title: Horse boarding
boarding.text: Your horse's boarding status and a monthly payment reminder.

rental.title: Horse rental
rental.text: Book a school horse for rides and trail outings.

events.title: Camps & parties
events.text: Summer camp, birthday parties, coaching and early stimulation.

admin.title: Management panel
admin.text: Daily attendance, pending payments and income & occupancy reports.

install.title: Installs like an app, from your browser
install.text: No App Store or Play Store needed. Open the app once and add it to your home screen: it gets its own icon and runs full screen.
